cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Let the Callback Claim Credit
cards.instruction: Get recognition by returning to an early overlooked contribution when its importance becomes undeniable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're locked out. Remember the spare key I put under the flowerpot? Lift it straight up, please; don't drag it across the key.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I told you we didn't need a spare there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then revise that assessment while you hold the pot. The key is underneath; pick it up before we debate the storage again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All right, it was a good idea. I'll open the door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My idea, please. Say that before you put the key in; once we're inside, you tend to call the whole thing obvious.
